summary.text: Cody Cumpston is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He ran for the same seat in 2024, losing to incumbent Republican Jeffrey Stephens.

paragraphs.text: Cumpston said in a Ballotpedia survey that Marshall County has always been his home and that he and his wife, Erica, have been married 20 years and have two daughters.
He lost the 2024 general election for District 6 to Stephens, 56.1 percent to 43.9 percent.
In 2026 he advanced from the Democratic primary on May 12 and faces Republican Don Dewitt, who defeated Stephens in the Republican primary.
In the survey, Cumpston listed pro-family, pro-affordability and pro-working-class as his key messages.
He said he wants to focus on creating good jobs, strengthening unions, lowering everyday costs and supporting local businesses, and he named IBEW 141 as an endorser.
